title: namedargs2cell
summary: Convert a scalar name-value struct into an alternating name/value cell row.

gpu_support.notes: Host scalar-structure transformation; top-level resident numeric values reject without provider access.

description: `namedargs2cell(S)` preserves scalar struct field order and returns `{name1, value1, name2, value2, ...}` for name-value forwarding patterns.
behaviors: The input must be a scalar structure; top-level integer and resident numeric inputs reject without conversion or provider access.
Field names retain structure insertion order and field values are moved unchanged into alternating name/value cells.
All eight integer classes stored in fields retain their exact class and payload, including wide `int64` and `uint64` values.
